notAffected.impact: The advisory concerns the deprecated OpenPGP packages. None of Nylzo's six supported build targets imports or links those packages. Other packages from golang.org/x/crypto remain in use. This assessment does not apply to a build that adds OpenPGP.

The advisory concerns the deprecated OpenPGP packages. Neither Linux build of the Caddy that Nylzo releases imports or links them; both use the nobadger, nomysql and nopgx tags. Other packages from golang.org/x/crypto remain in use. This assessment does not apply to a build that adds OpenPGP.

picomatch runs only in lint, build and test tools (Vite, Vitest, the Svelte and Tailwind Vite plugins, knip and a lint plugin), which match glob patterns written in this repository. It is no runtime dependency of any web workspace, which the dependency gate checks against web/bun.lock, so the web client does not contain it and no outside input reaches it. Replace this assessment with an upstream fix when one is released.
